title: Sight Words
rule: Some words do not follow the phonics rules. We learn them by sight.
trickText: Look at the whole word. Say it out loud. These words are tricky, so we just remember them.
say: Today's case: sight words. These words are sneaky. They do not follow the rules, so we learn them by sight. Try to read each one before you tap.

activities.instruction: Read the word out loud. Tap I read it, or tap Hear it if you need help.
